bonus.name: Fey Step
entries: The spirit magically teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The spirit has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of this turn.

bonus.name: Fey Step
entries: The spirit magically teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. {@actSave wis} DC equals your spell save DC, one creature the spirit can see within 10 feet of itself. {@actSaveFail} The target is {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you and the spirit for 1 minute or until the target takes any damage.

bonus.name: Fey Step
entries: The spirit magically teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The spirit fills a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} within 5 feet of it with magical Darkness, which lasts until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: 虛體通行（僅幽體）
entries: 靈魄可以移動穿過其他生物或物件，如同穿過{@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB|困難地形}一般。如果它結束其回合時還處於物件內，其將被移入最近的未佔據空間中並受到每被移5尺{@damage 1d10}力場傷害。

action.name: 多重攻擊
entries: 靈魄發動等於法術環階一半次數的攻擊（向下取整）。

action.name: 致死之觸（僅幽體）
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack 加值等於你的法術攻擊加值}，觸及 5 尺。{@h}{@damage 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel}點暗蝕傷害，且目標陷入{@condition Frightened|XPHB|恐懼}狀態直至其下個回合結束。

action.name: 暗澹箭（僅骷髏）
entries: {@atkr r} {@hitYourSpellAttack 加值等於你的法術攻擊加值}, 射程150尺。{@h}{@damage 2d4 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} 暗蝕傷害。

action.name: 腐滅爪擊（僅腐屍）
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack 加值等於你的法術攻擊加值}，觸及 5 尺。{@h}{@damage 1d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel}點揮砍傷害。若目標已陷入{@condition Poisoned|XPHB|中毒}狀態，則其還會陷入{@condition Paralyzed|XPHB|麻痺}狀態，直至其下個回合結束。
